audit.why: Akali ahead 1-5, Skill at 6, and Kayle taking over on items matches 47.9% Emerald+ over 803 games and the disk chart. Chart untouched; why text now names the real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text credited Kayle's ranged autos to her E (Starfire Spellblade) at level 6.
audit.why: Riot's text puts the range/attack-speed/move-speed growth on the passive Divine Ascent, which scales as she levels and spends points. Starfire Spellblade is an on-next-attack missing-health nuke on 8s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, mid, whys[3] now credit Divine Ascent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Radiant Blast was never mentioned anywhere in the matchup, and Kayle's heal was repeatedly attributed to her passive.
audit.why: Radiant Blast (Q, 900 range, 12s at rank 1) slows AND reduces resistances - it is her main lane tool. Her heal is Celestial Blessing (W, flat 15s), not the passive.
audit.corrected: Added Radiant Blast to breakdown.early/cooldowns/trading, tradeGood, phases[1].why; moved every heal claim onto Celestial Blessing's 15s.

audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80 - 160s at rank 1 is nearly three minutes of nothing. That number is what makes baiting it worth doing.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns now carry 160s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kayle referred to as 'he'/'his' in five places.
audit.why: Kayle is female; the mismatch reads as boilerplate and undercuts trust.
audit.corrected: breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late, dontsFull[0].d and phases[1].why corrected.

edits.before: Crush her early — E-Q bully before she scales. Akali wins the Divine Judgment cooldown windows.
edits.after: Crush her early — E-Q bully before she scales. Akali wins the 160s Divine Judgment windows.

edits.before: Bully her early and deny CS. Track Divine Judgment before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Bully her early and deny CS. Track Divine Judgment (160s at rank 1) before every commit and hold the wave.

edits.before: Kayle wins by landing Divine Judgment, denying your pattern, and kiting you off the wave.
edits.after: Kayle wins by landing Radiant Blast, blanking your burst with Divine Judgment, and kiting.

edits.before: Q Kayle at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Q Kayle at max blade range, E-dash in while Radiant Blast is on its 12s, and shroud the return fire.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Respect Kayle's Divine Judgment completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Sidestep Radiant Blast — it slows and cuts your resistances — and bank small advantages instead of proving a point.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Divine Judgment: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade around Celestial Blessing's 15s heal and Radiant Blast's 12s: with both down, run the full pattern. If ahead, freeze and starve her.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment: matchup-defining — Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kayle Divine Judgment: matchup-defining — 160s at rank 1. Bait it and she is naked for minutes. - Radiant Blast: 12s, slows and shreds your resistances — sidestep it. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Good trade: Q Kayle at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire. Great trade: Kayle wastes Divine Judgment (Invuln) — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Good trade: Q Kayle at max blade range, E-dash in while Radiant Blast is on its 12s, and shroud the return fire. Great trade: Kayle burns Divine Judgment — that is 160 seconds without invulnerability, so commit everything. Bad trade: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.

edits.before: Best wave: held near your side so Kayle overextends into your pattern. Worst wave: shoved to his tower with your key cooldowns down. Crash timing: crash only to reset, take plates, or set up a roam — never on autopilot.
edits.after: Best wave: held near your side so Kayle overextends into your pattern. Worst wave: shoved to her tower with your key cooldowns down. Crash timing: crash only to reset, take plates, or set up a roam — never on autopilot.

edits.after: If Kayle gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Divine Judgment. Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If she snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.

edits.before: "This is Akali's lane to dominate: Kayle is melee, slow, and last-hit-dependent until level 6, so YOU out-range and out-trade her. Throw Q from max range to land the ring, then walk through it for the empowered Assassin's Mark auto and back off — every short trade is yours, and her only answer is to safe-farm and heal with her passive. Hold Shroud for when she has a jungler, deny her CS, and crash waves to keep her pinned under tower. The goal is simple: arrive at 6 with her already behind so your all-in is lethal."
edits.after: "This is Akali's lane to dominate: Kayle is melee, slow, and last-hit-dependent until level 6, so YOU out-range and out-trade her. Throw Q from max range to land the ring, then walk through it for the empowered Assassin's Mark auto and back off. Sidestep Radiant Blast — it slows and shreds your resistances on a 12s cooldown — and her only other answer is Celestial Blessing's 15s heal. Hold Shroud for when she has a jungler, deny her CS, and crash waves to keep her pinned under tower. Arrive at 6 with her already behind so your all-in is lethal."

edits.before: "Everything is racing Kayle's level-6 spike, not yours. The moment she hits 6 her E grants ranged autos and her waveclear comes online, so the window just before and at your own 6 is your single best all-in: E-flip to mark her, R cast one through her, then re-dash for the missing-health execute on cast two, using Shroud mid-combo to dodge a counter or reset if she peels. Bait her into burning E or a heal before you commit. Land this with your first AP item and she's dead before she ever reaches two — fail to kill, and you've just handed the scaling carry free time."
edits.after: "Everything is racing Kayle's level-6 spike, not yours. Her passive Divine Ascent is what hands her the ranged autos and waves of fire as she levels, and her waveclear arrives with it, so the window at your own 6 is your single best all-in: E-flip to mark her, R cast one through her, then re-dash for the missing-health execute on cast two, using Shroud mid-combo to dodge a counter or reset if she peels. Bait Celestial Blessing's 15s heal before you commit. Land this with your first AP item and she's dead before she ever reaches two — fail to kill, and you've handed the scaling carry free time."

edits.before: Your R level isn't her timer — HERS is: at champ level 6 Kayle's E grants ranged autos and her wave starts clearing, so all-in with E into both R casts NOW while she's still melee and itemless.
edits.after: Your R level isn't her timer — HERS is: as Kayle levels, Divine Ascent hands her ranged autos and her wave starts clearing, so all-in with E into both R casts NOW while she's short-ranged and itemless.

edits.before: Kayle is melee, slow, and farm-reliant at level 1 while you out-range her with Q and heal through trades with your empowered Assassin's Mark auto.
edits.after: Kayle is melee, slow, and farm-reliant at level 1 while you out-range her with Q — her attack range only grows as Divine Ascent levels up.

edits.before: Through levels 3-5 you keep bullying a melee Kayle who can only safe-farm and passive-heal, building the lead you need before her 6.
edits.after: Through levels 3-5 you keep bullying a melee Kayle who can only safe-farm and heal on Celestial Blessing's 15s, building the lead you need.

edits.before: Your level-6 all-in — E-flip into both R casts — kills a still-melee, itemless Kayle before her ranged E and scaling ever arrive; this is your peak window.
edits.after: Your level-6 all-in — E-flip into both R casts — kills a still-melee, itemless Kayle before Divine Ascent's ranged form and her scaling arrive; this is your peak.

edits.before: Survive lane by safe-farming under tower with E and her passive heal until she reaches her ranged level-6/item spike
edits.after: Survive lane by safe-farming under tower with Celestial Blessing's 15s heal until she reaches her ranged and item spike

notes: Akali's Assassin's Mark does not heal - Riot's text gives bonus range and damage only. The Kayle file claimed 'heal through trades with your empowered Assassin's Mark auto' in whys[0]; removed. Kayle's ranged form comes from the passive Divine Ascent, not from E.
